overall_goal: Clean utensils, retrieve ingredients, and log recipe details in the notebook.

goals.rationale: The person wipes the scissors with a tablecloth and places them inside the drawer.

goals.description: Organize jars on the tabletop and store an onion
goals.rationale: The person moves jars to make space on the tabletop, places an onion inside the drawer, and retrieves more jars from the cabinet.

goals.description: Search for and retrieve noodles and kidney beans from the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person looks through the cabinet, moving boxes to find and extract a pack of noodles and kidney beans.

goals.description: Search for and retrieve pulses and vegetable oil from the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person continues searching the cabinet, taking out a packet of pulses and temporarily handling a bottle of vegetable oil.

goals.description: Weigh butter and record its weight
goals.rationale: The person uses a spoon and a weighing balance to measure the butter and writes the weight in the notebook.

goals.description: Retrieve a spoon from the drawer
goals.rationale: The person places a used spoon down and gets a new one from the drawer.

goals.description: Record initial ingredients and weights in the notebook
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly writes down the ingredients and their weights, such as cumin seeds, in the notebook.

goals.description: Log recipe steps and ingredients in the notebook
goals.rationale: The person continues to write down the recipe steps and ingredient details in the notebook.

goals.description: Continue logging recipe steps and ingredients in the notebook
goals.rationale: The person finishes recording the remaining recipe steps and ingredients in the notebook.

goals.description: Retrieve a pressure cooker from the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person opens the cabinet, takes out a pressure cooker, and places it on the tabletop.
